definition: a long flat piece of sawn timber
description: A close overhead shot outdoors. A pale wooden board with a round hole cut through the middle is laid flat across the top of a big carved wooden bowl, with a crate of whole walnuts behind it. A hand picks a walnut out of the crate and sets it in the hole in the board so it sits held in place. A hammer swings down and cracks the walnut; the pieces of shell and the kernel drop straight through the hole into the bowl underneath. The hand fetches another walnut and does it again, and the bowl below slowly fills up with broken shells and pale nut kernels.
